literal: Unlearned having undertaken behaving flaw to be removed even that which is mastered doubt will yield
translation: Pretending to possess knowledge one has not learned will cast doubt even upon the subjects one has mastered flawlessly.
modern: படிக்காதவற்றைப் படித்ததாகக் காட்டிக்கொண்டு நடப்பது, ஒருவன் குற்றமறக் கற்று வல்லமையாக உள்ளவற்றின் மீதும் மற்றவர்களுக்குச் சந்தேகத்தை ஏற்படுத்தும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against the pretense of knowledge. When an ignorant person pretends to know things they have not actually learned, their behavior exposes their deceit. Consequently, others will begin to doubt even the genuine skills and knowledge that the person has mastered flawlessly. The word 'வல்லதூஉம்' uses a poetic elongation to emphasize that absolutely everything they are truly capable of becomes suspect.
